title: Linear systems and stochastic dynamics
summary: Neuromatch W2D3: linear dynamical systems and their eigen-solutions, Markov processes, the Ornstein–Uhlenbeck process as determinism plus noise, and autoregressive models fitted to time series; the mathematics of the reversible-reaction and membrane equations seen elsewhere, now as a general tool for neural signals.
